VMAX = max vertical line length (max run of consecutive 1s down any column with run length >= l_min=2); fail-closed if no qualifying vertical lines or VMAX<=0/non-finite. On trailing delay embedding (m=2,tau=1), L-inf recurrence eps=0.5*std(window). Causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if RTE/VMAX/ratio undefined/non-finite/degenerate or insufficient qualifying lines/gaps.

params.gap_definition: gap length w = number of consecutive 0-cells between successive recurrent points in a column (excluding trivial self at i==j)
